candidate_concepts.label: Augmented Analytics Definition
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics uses AI and machine learning to assist with data preparation, insight generation, and insight explanation, enhancing how people explore and analyze data in BI platforms.
coverage_criteria: Student can define augmented analytics in their own words.
Student can list the key components: data prep, insight generation, insight explanation.
Student can explain the role of AI/ML in augmented analytics.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The source explicitly defines augmented analytics in the opening sections, citing Gartner and explaining its components.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This candidate captures the core definition at a level checkable with 1-2 definitional questions.

candidate_concepts.label: Role of Machine Learning in Augmented Analytics
candidate_concepts.description: Machine learning reduces tedious data tasks and provides recommendations within BI platforms, learning user preferences to personalize analysis.
coverage_criteria: Student can explain how ML contributes to augmented analytics (e.g., automating cleaning, providing recommendations).
Student can give an example of ML personalization in analytics.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The section 'The role of machine learning in augmented analytics' explicitly describes how ML helps people in analysis and learns semantics and preferences.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This isolates ML's function from the broader definition, enabling focused questions on ML's specific contributions.

source_anchors.locator: The role of machine learning in augmented analytics

candidate_concepts.label: Augmented Analytics vs. Automation
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics guides users to discover insights, whereas automation removes human decision-making; augmentation preserves human context and domain knowledge.
coverage_criteria: Student can distinguish between augmented analytics and automation.
Student can explain why domain knowledge remains crucial in augmented analytics.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The section 'Augmented analytics vs. automation' clearly contrasts the two concepts and emphasizes the role of human context.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is a distinct comparison that is checkable with a few discriminative questions.

candidate_concepts.label: Target Users of Augmented Analytics
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics benefits business users, executives, analysts, and data stewards by enabling less technical users to get insights quickly and helping advanced users work faster.
coverage_criteria: Student can list the main user groups of augmented analytics.
Student can explain the specific value for each group.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Who is augmented analytics for?' section explicitly identifies user groups and their benefits.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is a self-contained topic about users, suitable for a short quiz.

candidate_concepts.label: Agility: Increasing Speed to Insight
candidate_concepts.description: AI-powered augmentation accelerates insight discovery by surfacing relevant data, suggesting paths, and personalizing over time based on user behavior.
coverage_criteria: Student can define agility in the context of augmented analytics.
Student can describe how augmented analytics increases speed to insight.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Agility: Increasing speed to insight' sub-section provides details on how augmentation accelerates analysis.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This is a single benefit with clear explanation, easily tested.

candidate_concepts.label: Accuracy: Providing a More Complete Picture
candidate_concepts.description: Machines perform thorough, repetitive analysis to uncover all relevant insights, helping humans avoid confirmation bias.
coverage_criteria: Student can explain how augmented analytics improves accuracy.
Student can describe how it helps avoid confirmation bias.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Accuracy' sub-section describes how AI looks under every rock to enable complete analysis.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: Single benefit, checkable with a few questions.

candidate_concepts.label: Efficiency: Automating Operational Tasks
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics automates repetitive tasks like data preparation, discovery, and statistical analysis, saving time and effort.
coverage_criteria: Student can give examples of tasks automated by augmented analytics.
Student can explain the efficiency benefit.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Efficiency' sub-section explains task automation as an augmented analytics benefit.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: Single benefit, clear scope.

candidate_concepts.label: Confidence: Powerful Analysis in Context
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics tools are easy to use, surface data in context, and integrate into workflows, allowing users to confirm instincts and make confident decisions.
coverage_criteria: Student can explain how augmented analytics builds user confidence.
Student can describe the role of context in analysis confidence.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Confidence' sub-section details how ease of use and context boost confidence in decisions.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: Single benefit, testable.

candidate_concepts.label: Automatic Data Identification
candidate_concepts.description: BI platforms with AI can automatically detect data attributes like geographic or personal information, and can read tables from PDFs and text documents for analysis.
coverage_criteria: Student can describe what automatic data identification does.
Student can give examples of detectable attributes.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The bolded 'Automatic data identification' paragraph explains this feature.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: A specific feature, small enough for one question.

candidate_concepts.label: Automated Statistical Technique Selection
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics can automatically select the best forecasting, clustering, and statistical algorithms and explain drivers behind outliers.
coverage_criteria: Student can identify what statistical techniques augmented analytics can automate.
Student can explain how it helps users without statistical expertise.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Statistical techniques' sub-section describes automatic algorithm selection and explanation.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: A specific feature, checkable.

candidate_concepts.label: Smart Data Preparation
candidate_concepts.description: Algorithms index and group related words, and recommend cleaning steps like removing nulls or splitting fields, minimizing manual data cleanup.
coverage_criteria: Student can list smart data prep capabilities.
Student can explain how it speeds data preparation.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Smart data prep' sub-section explains these algorithmic helps.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: Specific feature, small scope.

candidate_concepts.label: AI-Driven Recommendations
candidate_concepts.description: Augmented analytics systems provide recommendations for data sources, chart types, and relevant content based on user role and behavior, aiding onboarding and discovery.
coverage_criteria: Student can give examples of recommendations provided by augmented analytics.
Student can explain how recommendations help users.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Recommendations' sub-section details recommendation types across prep, discovery, analysis, and sharing.

candidate_concepts.label: Natural Language Interactions
candidate_concepts.description: Natural language query lets users type plain-language questions, and natural language generation creates textual explanations of insights, making data accessible without query language knowledge.
coverage_criteria: Student can define natural language query and generation in augmented analytics.
Student can explain how they lower the barrier to data analysis.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Natural language interactions' sub-section explains both query and generation capabilities.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: A distinct feature set, checkable.

candidate_concepts.label: Misconceptions of AI and ML
candidate_concepts.description: Misconceptions about AI and ML, such as fear of job replacement, can stall adoption of augmented analytics. Users need to understand and trust the value.

Student can explain the impact of misconceptions on adoption.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Misconceptions of AI and ML' section discusses barriers to adoption.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: This challenge is self-contained and checkable.

candidate_concepts.description: Machines lack full context and intent understanding, requiring human domain expertise; inflated expectations can lead to sunk costs.

extraction_reason.source_grounded_rationale: The 'Augmented analytics limitations' section details these pitfalls.
extraction_reason.granularity_rationale: A focused topic on limitations.
